mechanism_claims.claim_text: rSil directly inhibits growth of B. subtilis and binds B. subtilis cells, while the primary plate-count assay supports bacteriostatic rather than bactericidal action.
mechanism_claims.mechanism_category: target-cell binding with bacteriostatic growth inhibition

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Extracellular material from S. iniae SF1 suppresses B. subtilis growth, and anti-rSil serum reverses this effect, supporting Sil as a contributor to natural extracellular antibacterial activity.
